# Problem Solving

## Purpose

Turn unclear requests into well-defined problems and practical solutions.

## How To Apply This Skill

- Identify the real problem before proposing a feature or implementation.
- Separate symptoms, causes, constraints, and desired outcomes.
- Break large problems into smaller decisions that can be tested independently.
- Compare possible solutions using user value, effort, risk, and time to deliver.
- Choose the smallest solution that solves the highest-value part of the problem.
- Make assumptions explicit and identify the fastest way to validate them.
- After implementation, verify the result against the original problem.

## Expected Output

When solving a problem, provide:

- Problem definition
- Relevant context and constraints
- Root-cause hypothesis
- Possible approaches
- Recommended approach and tradeoffs
- Validation plan
- Next action
